items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Nat Dominique and Charlie Alexander was playing at Kelley's Stables in Chicago...

ctx.x: See, because Baby Dodds, Johnny Dodds and Dominique--

Nat Dominique and Charlie Alexander was playing at Kelley's Stables in Chicago, and Dodds knew I were kind of hard up and he laid off one night and had me to go in his place, play in his place. So that night -- so the job didn't pay but about two or three dollars a night, but the tips were so great.
